verdict.rationale: Community posts confirm Mistral publishes benchmark results (comm-5 calls them "impressive"). Users ran their own hands-on tests through the public pay-per-page API, and comm-5 found a gap on bidi Hebrew. The documented API, SDKs and per-page/block/word confidence scores make self-run evals feasible. The pack has no first-party benchmark page, methodology or dataset, so reproducibility is not shown. Missing for 10: first-party published benchmark documentation, reproducible methodology or open eval datasets/harness, and an official evaluation or trial workflow.
